initial.estimate_method: UTF-8 bytes / 4 with message framing and fixed image allowance; not provider-reported usage

contributions.name: Installed identity, guidance, skills and memory

limitations: Excludes the next user message, per-request date/identity suffix and dynamic retrieval.
Estimates include only effective history after compaction; raw archived history is not counted.
Image estimates use a fixed allowance, not provider-specific tiles or resolution.
Components round down individually; their sum can differ slightly from the total.
